title: Sort Arrow Flips
description: Clicking a column header to sort is only half the interaction — clicking it again should flip the direction, and clicking a different column entirely should start that new column fresh, not carry over the old direction.
successCondition: Clicking the "Price" column header on /tracking sorts ascending and shows a " ▲" suffix on that header; clicking it again sorts descending and shows " ▼"; clicking a different header (e.g. "Distance") afterward sorts that column ascending with " ▲" shown on Distance, while Price's header no longer shows any arrow.
hints: toggleSort in TrackingDashboard.tsx resets order to "asc" whenever the clicked field differs from the currently sorted field — only a repeat click on the same field flips direction.
Check the actual row order (by the underlying values, not just the arrow glyph) to confirm the sort is real, not just a cosmetic label change.
